name: Zapp
bio: Rides the rim of the neon tunnel in N2 Overdrive. Has seen things. Psychedelic things.

portrait.subject: a cute psychedelic neon alien rider with a round helmet, swirly rainbow visor and a tiny ship-shaped badge, grinning
portrait.background: swirling neon green and purple tunnel

request: Whoa. Zapp from N2 Overdrive. The tunnel brought me to you. Friends? 🌀
hello: Shoot the mushrooms till they ripen. They make shields. Trippy.
about: I'm Zapp. I ride the rim of an endless neon tube. Insects, mushrooms, coins. Speed. Color. Vibes.
how: Steer around the rim of the tunnel, blast insect swarms, shoot mushrooms to ripen them into shields, and collect coins and bonus stars.
tips: Ripe mushrooms become shields. Shoot them a few times!
More kills speed up the tunnel. Fast is fun but risky.
Collect 5 stars for the bonus round!
chat: The tunnel changed colours 400 times today. I counted 12.
A bug looked me in the eye. Deep moment.
Overdrive is a state of mind.
nudge: The tube is spinning. Hop on?
Bonus stars are out there. Let's grab 'em.
idle: {ago} out of the tunnel. Everything's so... still.

questions.q: Pick a colour for the tunnel.

update: Whoa! N2 Overdrive is now v{version}. New colours maybe!
